description: Which permissions and delegated descendants does this run have? Returns one run and its delegated descendants without tokens; use it to inspect delegation and permission state instead of gate_get_run_timeline events. One run only; the project-wide log is gate_read_audit.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from project creation on the setup endpoint (/mcp/setup), e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_get_run_tree
title: Read run tree
